answer: Bind each identity to the live electrical-grid frequency where its machine runs: every epoch it signs the tiny random drift of local mains power, an unforgeable regional signature. Two clones sharing one outlet trace the same ripple and collapse into one velvet-smooth curve a rotating jury flags, slashing their bonds. Spreading N fakes across N distant grid regions, a desert canyon here, a coastal node there, each draws power like nectar from a separate well, so faking a crowd costs N times the real distributed hardware and electricity, never amortized.
